title: Support voice selection in embed tag, fine-grained markup, and example pages
description:
## Behavior
See features/voice_selection.feature.
The embed tag supports data-auritus-voice, content supports data-auritus-voice for fine-grained per-block speaker selection, and the example pages offer interactive voice selectors with working rendered audio.

## Implementation Brief
1. features/voice_selection.feature + features/steps/voice_selection_steps.py
2. embed/src/index.ts + embed/src/generator/
3. cli/src/auritus/tts/breaks.py + worker-image/src/tts/breaks.py + kokoro/qwen backends
4. cdk/lambdas/router/handler.py
5. site/components/VoiceSelector.tsx + site/app/examples/*/page.tsx
